claims: Super Bowl LXI is scheduled for February 14, 2027.
Super Bowl LXI is scheduled at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.
Super Bowl LXI is the second time SoFi Stadium has hosted the Super Bowl.
Super Bowl LXI will be televised by ABC.
Super Bowl LXI will be simulcast on ESPN.
Super Bowl LXI is the first Super Bowl to fall on Valentine's Day.
Super Bowl LXI falls on a President's Day weekend.
SoFi Stadium is in the Greater Los Angeles Area.
Official tickets for Super Bowl LXI are not yet on sale.
Fans can place a $2,500 priority access deposit for guaranteed seats for Super Bowl LXI.
Priority for Super Bowl LXI seats is given to Rams season ticket members.
Super Bowl LXI will mark the ninth time the Super Bowl has been held in the Los Angeles area.
